body:
Root-caused a reported 'no damage' match log as correct armor-soak behavior (not a bug), then added per-both-player armor/energy/credits to the round-start log line so this is legible without investigation. Added apps/gui/sfx.c SFX_EXPLOSION/SFX_VICTORY cues wired into the existing fx_match_end() particle burst, a prominent web #end-banner (VICTORY/DEFEAT/DRAW) matching the desktop client's S_END screen, and a rings badge (= IDUNA game_player_stats.wins, reused via the existing public stats endpoint) next to the UTC clock. Found and fixed a real deployment process bug along the way: WOTAN/DEADWEIGHT's checked-in dist/ had drifted behind DEADWEIGHT's own source by several already-shipped features because wotan-deploy.sh's --delete rsync silently reverts any ad hoc direct-to-/var/www deploy on its next run. Redeployed properly through the WOTAN checkout (WOTAN@2597ce5) and verified live via byte-for-byte diff against the local build. DEADWEIGHT@49f5d29.

⚓ ☃
title: Match-end VICTORY/DEFEAT banner, rings badge, explosion/victory SFX; fixed stale WOTAN deploy
